title: Lagune configs
description: A Lagune project's configs: the categories it uses and the index of its own specializations.

$schema.description: The address of the schema this file follows.

categories.description: The categories whose built-in specializations join the project's catalog. While absent, the project uses owasp alone.

catalog.description: The index of the project's own specializations, each one winning over a built-in of the same name.

name.description: The specialization's name, also the name of its file in .lagune/catalog/.

tags.description: What the specialization covers, matched against the project's code.
